newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, fundamentals balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, fundamentals balanced.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Wednesday, supported by a jump in crude futures and balanced fundamentals in Europe, traders said.
End-users appeared satisfied for October and trading was thin after an industry function here on Wednesday, they said.
November swaps edged up to $220/221 and December swaps were notionally assessed at $215/$216. Traders said naphtha still lagged the strong gains in crude and gasoline.
"It is very quiet on both the physical and the swaps," said one trader. "For October most end-users have done what they have to do. November is an open book."
